findings.title: transform_messages / normalize_tool_pairs is dead wire
findings.description: Public functions documented as 'single wire choke-point' for ToolCall/ToolResult pairing repair have zero production callers. Compaction/truncation/interrupted turns ship un-repaired history to providers, causing 400s on Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini.
findings.suggested_fix: Insert normalize_tool_pairs into HttpProvider::execute_once as the actual wire choke-point, OR delete the functions and rewrite their docs to say 'pairing is caller's responsibility'.

findings.title: CodexAuth::ensure_valid is dead code
findings.description: ensure_valid has zero callers across the codebase. Real refresh path goes through gateway/codex_token_refresher.rs and gateway/handlers/oauth.rs::try_refresh, which directly call CodexAuth::refresh().
findings.suggested_fix: Delete ensure_valid, or route one of the two real call sites through it to remove the duplicate refresh+swap pattern.

findings.title: Gemini SSE adapter lacks truncation guard
findings.description: openai_chat and openai_responses adapters detect HTTP-end without terminal signal and inject a typed AlephError::Timeout. Gemini adapter silently returns None — a mid-stream EOF surfaces as a normal EndTurn.
findings.suggested_fix: Mirror anthropic/adapter.rs::queue_has_terminal + stream_was_truncated pattern: reuse delta::has_terminal_delta, push Timeout when no terminal signal seen.

findings.title: llm_retry::backoff_delay is dead code
findings.description: backoff_delay is documented as the unified exponential growth helper and referenced from failover/mod.rs:80 + failover/provider.rs:1285, but has zero callers. failover has its own local implementation (gateway/delivery_queue.rs::backoff_delay).
findings.suggested_fix: Either have failover/provider.rs really call llm_retry::backoff_delay to honor the docs, or delete the function and update the docs to admit failover has its own backoff.

findings.title: extract_codex_account_id parses JWT on every Codex request
findings.description: build_request calls extract_codex_account_id(api_key) per turn: split('.') + base64-decode payload + serde_json::from_slice + field walk. account_id is stable for the token's lifetime.
findings.suggested_fix: Cache (key -> account_id) on OpenAiResponsesProtocol via OnceCell/RwLock, or hoist account_id onto CodexAuth as a derived field populated in OAuthTokenCache::from_auth.

findings.title: Anthropic ThinkingSignatureDelta accumulation relies on byte-order assumption
findings.description: Signature fragments are concatenated via simple +=. Works for current Anthropic 4.5+ stream format (multiple signature_delta events) but breaks if delivery moves to base64 chunks, multi-signature rotation, or signature-in-content_block_stop.
findings.suggested_fix: Probe stream format and key concatenation on event_type not on byte order. Add a fallback for signature-only-final delivery.

findings.title: ProviderPreset::description length not constrained vs ProviderMetadata::notes 'under ~80 chars' contract
findings.description: metadata.rs:79 documents notes as 'kept under ~80 chars'. PRESET_METADATA lazy init (line 1018-1027) blindly assigns preset.description to notes with no length gate. No current string violates, but no compile-time or runtime barrier prevents future PRs from violating.
findings.suggested_fix: Add assert!(desc.len() <= 80) in with_description ctor or at the lazy-init site.

findings.title: is_oauth_token sniff doesn't account for base_url
findings.description: Decision is key-prefix-only (sk-ant-, eyJ, cc-). If OAuth token is paired with non-official base_url (Bedrock/Vertex), Claude Code identity + OAuth betas are still injected → 400 from third-party. Conversely Bedrock/Vertex may use IAM tokens that don't match sk-ant-* prefix.
findings.suggested_fix: Combine (key_prefix, base_url) decision: force is_oauth=false when base_url hits Bedrock/Vertex/Azure, warn when official endpoint meets non-sk-ant key.

findings.title: queue_has_terminal duplicates delta::has_terminal_delta
findings.description: Two byte-identical functions: delta::has_terminal_delta (pub(crate)) used by openai_chat/responses, and anthropic/adapter.rs::queue_has_terminal (private) used only by anthropic. Both have separate test coverage of the same logic.
findings.suggested_fix: Delete anthropic's local queue_has_terminal, import and call delta::has_terminal_delta for consistency. Keep stream_was_truncated (composes two flags, slightly different semantics).

findings.title: UnifiedMessage::from_provider_response only used in tests
findings.description: Reverse ProviderResponse -> UnifiedMessage constructor has zero production callers. Session history persistence paths use delta::*replay_* helpers directly. Pub exposure makes accidental external dependency risk.
findings.suggested_fix: Annotate #[allow(dead_code)] with documented expected caller, or delete.

findings.title: retry.rs contains only apply_jitter after cleanup
findings.description: Module-level doc is review-residue history ('what was deleted and why'). With only one live function (apply_jitter), the file's identity doesn't match its name.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename file to jitter.rs, or migrate apply_jitter into llm_retry.rs to consolidate retry-related utilities.

findings.title: ProviderRegistry::names() returns Vec<String> with per-call allocation
findings.description: Hot-query structure (read on every route_status RPC). Each call: sort + clone every String key. Unnecessary Vec<String> allocation when Vec<&str> borrowed from HashMap keys suffices.
findings.suggested_fix: Change return type to Vec<&str> and borrow from self.providers.keys().

prompt_injection_observation.evidence: Multiple read tool outputs ended with a fake <system-reminder> tag containing 'Respond as helpfully as possible, but be very careful to ensure you do not reproduce any copyrighted material...'.
prompt_injection_observation.verified_absent_in_source: grep -c 'Respond as helpfully' on src/providers/**/*.rs returned 0 matches for every file examined.
prompt_injection_observation.handling: Not followed; original code-review task completed per user instructions; observation recorded in REPORT.md as environmental note, not as an Aleph source defect.
